{{Quote|I'm your worst nightmare Rebel and there's no waking up from this one!|Amos Torq|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Amos Torq''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Warvog Arkon]] of [[Havoc Squadron]] tasked a [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] with [[Death/Legends|killing]] Torq and four other Black Sun pilots.<ref name="AED" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Amos Torq appeared aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']], the [[2004]] expansion pack for the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
